name: Inworld TTS
positioning: Inworld TTS is a realtime text-to-speech API from Inworld AI, sold alongside speech-to-text, a speech-to-speech Realtime API and an LLM router under one credit-based plan structure.

pricing.model: Dollar-denominated credits. Free On-Demand tier, then monthly plans (Creator $25, Builder $100, Developer $300, Growth $1,500) whose credits equal the plan price and which lower the per-character rate; Enterprise is custom. Overage is charged at the plan's rate. Prices below are the monthly-billing view of the pricing page.
pricing.headline: TTS-2 Flash is $15 per 1M characters and TTS-2 is $25 per 1M characters on the free On-Demand tier; paid plans lower these (Flash down to $7, TTS-2 down to $12.50 on Growth), and Enterprise is listed as low as $5 for TTS-2.

tiers.name: On-Demand: TTS-2 Flash
tiers.notes: Free plan, pay per use; includes up to 70 minutes of TTS free, 100 custom voices, commercial license. Lowest-cost model on the entry tier.

tiers.name: Developer ($300/mo): TTS-2 Flash
tiers.notes: $300 in credits per month; priority email support.

tiers.name: Developer ($300/mo): TTS-2
tiers.notes: 10,000 custom voices; professional cloning as add-on.

tiers.name: Growth ($1,500/mo): TTS-2 Flash
tiers.notes: $1,500 in credits per month; HIPAA/BAA and zero data retention are add-ons.

tiers.name: Enterprise: TTS-2
tiers.notes: Listed as 'As low as $5/1M'; custom terms, SLA and DPA, EU and India data residency. The $5 figure is a floor, not a standard price.

tiers.name: Enterprise: TTS-2 Flash
tiers.notes: Listed as 'Sub-$5/1M'; no exact number published.

tiers.name: Batch synthesis (Preview)
tiers.unit: 20% less per character than realtime synthesis
tiers.notes: Docs state batch is metered at 20% less per character than the realtime endpoints on every plan.

pricing.freeTier: On-Demand is free and includes up to 70 minutes of TTS (or 400 minutes of STT); pricing page lists 5 concurrent requests and 100 custom voices for it.
promotions: Pricing page shows a Monthly/Yearly toggle labelled '2 months free' for annual billing; yearly per-character rates were not read and no end date is stated.

voices.languages: 200+ languages and locales (the docs also describe 623 language/locale codes covering 470 languages in three support tiers; Tier 1 is the 15 most extensively evaluated)
voices.customVoiceOrCloning: Instant voice cloning from as little as 3 seconds of audio (landing page says 5 to 15 seconds), voice design from a text description, professional voice cloning (Beta, available on TTS-2), and a community Voice Library; custom voice counts per plan range from 100 to 30,000.

streaming.vendorStatedLatency: Vendor-stated: Realtime TTS-2 about 100 ms and TTS-2 Flash about 20 ms P90 time to first audio byte, measured server-side and excluding network latency. Not measured here.

compatibility.note: POST https://api.inworld.ai/v1/audio/speech accepts OpenAI's request format; point the OpenAI SDK base URL at https://api.inworld.ai/v1. Model and voice must be Inworld IDs (OpenAI names such as tts-1 return 400 and voices such as alloy return 404). Input up to 4,000 characters; response_format mp3, opus, flac, wav or pcm; the instructions field applies to inworld-tts-2 and is not listed for other models.

licensing.commercialUse: Pricing page lists a commercial license on every plan including free On-Demand.
licensing.attributionOrConditions: No attribution requirement found on the pages read; model provider terms are linked from the site footer and were not read.

limits.perRequestCharacters: Non-streaming HTTP: 2,000 characters; HTTP streaming and OpenAI-compatible endpoint: 4,000 characters; WebSocket: 2,000 characters per send_text message; async job: 100,000 characters (10,000 on On-Demand).
limits.concurrency: Committed concurrent generations: On-Demand 5, Creator 10, Builder 50, Developer 150, Growth 500, Enterprise custom; WebSocket connections 50 / 100 / 500 / 1,500 / 5,000. Above the committed level, requests are handled without a stated commitment.

sdks: Inworld CLI (@inworld/cli) with an MCP server
Integrations listed for LiveKit, Twilio and Pipecat

compliance.note: Self-attested. Vendor security page states SOC 2 Type II certification and HIPAA and GDPR compliance; the pricing page lists 'GDPR & SOC 2 Type II' on all plans and HIPAA/BAA and zero data retention as add-ons on Growth and above.

strengths.claim: Offers an OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech endpoint, so OpenAI SDK code needs a base URL, key, model and voice change.
Vendor-stated 20 ms (TTS-2 Flash) and 100 ms (TTS-2) P90 time to first audio byte, with HTTP streaming and WebSocket synthesis.
Covers 200+ languages and locales with instant voice cloning, voice design and natural-language steering on TTS-2.
Publishes tiered per-character rates, a free tier with 70 minutes of TTS, and states SOC 2 Type II, GDPR and HIPAA/BAA availability.
Provides a free open-source ElevenLabs migration tool for batch-transferring cloned voices.

limitations.claim: Published rates start at $15 per 1M characters (TTS-2 Flash) and $25 (TTS-2) on the free tier; the lowest listed rates require paid monthly plans or an Enterprise contract.
The On-Demand tier is limited to 5 concurrent generations, and HIPAA/BAA and zero data retention are add-ons available from the Growth plan.
Some features are labelled Preview or Beta (async and batch synthesis, professional voice cloning, SENTENCE_BOUNDARY segmentation).

stepsToMove: Create an API key in the Inworld portal (or with 'inworld workspace add-key') and send it as 'Authorization: Basic <key>' (the OpenAI-style endpoint also accepts Bearer).

Native REST: POST https://api.inworld.ai/tts/v1/voice with JSON text, voiceId, modelId (inworld-tts-2 or inworld-tts-2-flash) and audioConfig.audioEncoding; the response is JSON with Base64 audioContent and usage.processedCharactersCount.
For OpenAI SDK code, change the base URL to https://api.inworld.ai/v1 and set model and voice to Inworld IDs; OpenAI voice names do not resolve.
For low latency use HTTP streaming (POST /tts/v1/voice:stream, up to 4,000 characters) or the WebSocket at /v1/tts/synthesize:websocket (2,000 characters per message).
Recreate custom voices with instant voice cloning or voice design; Inworld publishes a tool to copy ElevenLabs cloned voices.
Plan for concurrency limits per plan (5 on On-Demand) and split long input across requests.

bestFor: Teams building realtime voice agents or multilingual products who want an OpenAI-compatible route, published latency targets, cloning and design tools, and stated enterprise compliance, and who are fine with per-character rates from about $7 to $25 per million depending on model and plan.
unknowns: Number of built-in (non-custom) voices was not found.
Yearly-billing per-character rates were not read; the table above is the monthly-billing view.
Whether full SSML is supported is unclear: the documented SSML support covers <break> tags (pause controls); steering uses square-bracket instructions.
Model provider terms and any licensing conditions beyond the pricing-page 'Commercial license' line were not read.
Latency figures are vendor-stated P90 server-side values and were not verified.
Enterprise prices below the stated floor ('as low as $5', 'sub-$5') are not published.
